bias.en: Neutral · jumped above the averages on heavy volume
bias.zh: 中性 · 放量升穿均线

read.en: SpaceX rose 7.8% on Oct 21 to $159.31, trading between $156.93 and $166.18 on volume 2.6 times its 20-day average, with no 100-day average yet (91 sessions). It is above the falling 5-day ($149.9), rising 30-day ($153.6) and falling 10-day ($154.5) averages. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 14 but above zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 14 ($170.60), and RSI is 56.
read.zh: SpaceX 10月21日上涨 7.8%，收于 $159.31，盘中区间 $156.93–166.18，成交量为 20 日均量的 2.6 倍；上市仅 91 个交易日，尚无 100 日均线。股价位于下行的 5 日（$149.9）、上行的 30 日（$153.6）和下行的 10 日均线（$154.5）上方。MACD 自 10月14日起位于信号线下方，仍在零轴之上，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月14日起看空（$170.60），RSI 为 56。

read.en: The jump broke all three written resistances ($148.6, $153.3, $158), though the close faded from the $166.2 high. Resistance is $166.2 (day's high, Oct 12 high $167.1), then $170.6 (SAR) and $176.4 (Oct 6 high). Support is $158 (Sep 21 high), then $154 (10 and 30-day) and $145.4 (Sep 28 low). A close above $166.2 would target $176.4; a close below $153.6 would reopen $145.4.
